1.
The Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 347/2021, registered at P.S. Chandni mahal for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The request for quashing is premised on a Settlement Agreement executed before the Counselling Cell, Family Courts, Tis Hazari Court.

entities.text: Counselling Cell, Family Courts, Tis Hazari Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is submitted that the payments due under the Settlement Agreement stand discharged and only an amount of INR 1,00,000/- remains outstanding, for which the Petitioners have prepared a demand draft drawn in favour of the complainant.
3. It is further submitted that the parties have obtained a divorce in terms of the settlement.
4. Issue notice to Respondent No. 2, through the Investigating Officer, returnable on the next date of hearing.
